facts.text: The resort is in Jimbaran, Bali, and is situated near the beach.
facts.excerpt: This hotel in Jimbaran, Bali, is situated near the beach.

facts.text: The resort is a short drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport and attractions like Garuda Wisnu Kencana Culture Park.
facts.excerpt: Our resort is a short drive away from Ngurah Rai International Airport and attractions like...See More Garuda Wisnu Kencana Culture Park.

facts.text: The resort has an outdoor lagoon pool of 1,300 square meters.
facts.excerpt: Take the plunge in our Jimbaran resort’s 1,300-square-meter outdoor lagoon pool

facts.text: The lagoon pool has a swim-up pool bar for cocktails.
facts.excerpt: we also have a swim-up pool bar for cocktails at the ready

facts.text: The Aqua Pool Sky Penthouse and the villas have a private pool.
facts.excerpt: Choose our Aqua Pool Sky Penthouse or a Jimbaran villa and enjoy a private pool

facts.text: Some rooms have lagoon access from the balcony.
facts.excerpt: Larger Guest room, 1 King, Lagoon access, Balcony

facts.text: Guests can enjoy ocean, lagoon or garden views from their balcony.
facts.excerpt: Sip your morning coffee or recharge on your balcony while enjoying the ocean, lagoon, or garden views.

facts.text: Suites with deep soaking tubs and lagoon views suit romantic getaways.
facts.excerpt: Jimbaran suites with deep soaking tubs and lagoon views make our hotel ideal for romantic getaways

facts.text: The Explore Spa offers Bali spa massages, many treatments using plant-based ingredients, including facials and body wraps.
facts.excerpt: Choose Bali spa massages from a menu of treatments, many using plant-based ingredients, including facials and body wraps.

facts.text: Sky Bar offers handcrafted cocktails with panoramic views of Jimbaran Bay and its sunsets.
facts.excerpt: Savor sweet and savory delights while enjoying panoramic views of Jimbaran Bay and one of Bali’s most breathtaking sunsets.

facts.text: Bamboo Chic serves Asian flavors and international favorites with an interactive open kitchen.
facts.excerpt: where authentic Asian flavors meet international favorites. Enjoy carefully curated buffet selections, signature dishes, and an interactive open-kitchen concept

facts.text: The Family Kids Club offers arts and crafts, interactive games and outdoor adventures for children.
facts.excerpt: From arts and crafts to interactive games and outdoor adventures, kids can explore their creativity and develop new skills in a safe, welcoming space.

facts.text: There is a separate outdoor kids pool.
